invariants: PAD is a veto — any pad_vetoed pair forces NoMatch regardless of accumulated match evidence
Temporal coherence — alternating identities (match,no-match,match) never resolve to Match
Hard 5s deadline — caller signals via timeout(); classified Timeout unless PAD already vetoed
Privacy-safe trace — DecisionTrace carries only scalar scores + booleans; no embeddings/frames/pixels

tests.name: high_confidence_first_pair_exits_immediately
tests.given: Balanced policy, first pair score 0.70 is_match=true pad_vetoed=false

tests.name: ambiguous_first_pair_continues_to_second
tests.given: Balanced policy, first pair score 0.50 (below 0.62 high-confidence bar) is_match=true

tests.name: consistent_matches_across_pair_cap_resolve_to_match
tests.then: Continue, Continue, Match at pair cap

tests.name: pad_veto_always_produces_no_match
tests.given: Balanced policy, first pair score 0.80 is_match=true pad_vetoed=true

tests.name: pad_veto_mid_sequence_forces_no_match
tests.given: Strict policy, second pair pad_vetoed=true after first continuing match

tests.name: timeout_after_pad_veto_still_no_match
tests.given: PAD already vetoed on first pair

tests.name: strict_and_balanced_thresholds_differ
tests.then: Strict threshold 0.78 > Balanced 0.62; Strict max_pairs=5 > Balanced 3; both deadlines 5s

tests.name: consistent_non_matches_resolve_to_no_match
tests.then: Continue, Continue, NoMatch at pair cap

tests.name: strict_does_not_early_exit_below_its_threshold
tests.given: Strict policy (threshold 0.78), first pair score 0.70 (≥Balanced but <Strict)

tests.name: trace_is_privacy_safe
tests.then: No biometric field names (embedding/frame/pixel/template/vector/0x) appear; only scalar score + is_match + pad_vetoed per pair
